title: Coppermine expedition
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Coppermine expedition", at revision 1360602487, opens: "The Coppermine expedition of 1819–1822 was a British overland undertaking to survey and chart the area from Hudson Bay to the north coast of North America, eastwards from the mouth of the Coppermine River. The expedition was organised by the Royal Navy as part of its attempt to discover and map the Northwest Passage. The first of three Arctic expeditions that were led by John Franklin, it involved George Back and John Richardson, both of whom later became notable Arctic explorers in their own right." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2328, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "British overland Arctic survey expedition, 1819–1822". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
